description: This PHP source file defines the LeavePeriodDao class, which manages data access related to leave periods in the OrangeHRM system. It handles operations such as saving leave period history and retrieving current or historical leave period records.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for LeavePeriodHistory, responsible for database interactions related to leave period history management in the HRM system.

methods.name: saveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Persists a LeavePeriodHistory object into the database, handling transaction management and calling specific strategies if leave periods are changed.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent LeavePeriodHistory entry, representing the current leave period start date and month.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Returns a list of all LeavePeriodHistory entries ordered by creation date and ID.
